suspicion_context: You were stopped after entering the building with temporary contractor access shortly after the security system recorded repeated failed login attempts from an unidentified account.
player_backstory: You claim to be an external contractor attending a scheduled meeting with the IT department to carry out a system audit.

clues.name: Access Log Terminal
clues.description: A terminal displaying recent failed system access attempts.
detail_points: Access denied 3 times within one hour
Connection originated from an external network
clues.supports: Raises suspicion because the failed attempts occurred shortly before the player's arrival, although the account is not identified as belonging to the player.

clues.name: Unclaimed Jacket
clues.description: A jacket containing several ordinary personal items.
detail_points: Pocket contains a meeting schedule for 14:30
Company-branded notebook in the inside pocket
No identification belonging to the player
clues.supports: Provides background context but has no direct connection to the player's claim.

clues.name: Confidential File Box
clues.description: A secured file box containing restricted project documents.
detail_points: Security seal shows signs of recent handling
clues.supports: Raises concern because restricted material appears to have been recently handled, although there is no direct evidence identifying the player as responsible.

clues.name: Asset-Tagged Office Laptop
clues.description: A company laptop carrying a standard asset identification tag.
clues.supports: Standard office equipment with no direct connection to the player's presence.

clues.name: Contractor Access Approval Email
clues.description: A printed email approving temporary contractor access.
clues.supports: Directly supports the player's claim that temporary access to the building was approved.

clues.name: IT Department Appointment Letter
clues.description: A letter confirming a scheduled contractor meeting.
detail_points: Authorised by: John Doe, IT Manager
clues.supports: Strongly supports the player's stated reason for being in the office.
